## Summary

Briefly describe the changes introduced in this Pull Request and the problem they solve.

## Type of Change

- [ ] **Bug Fix** (non-breaking change that resolves an issue)
- [ ] **Feature** (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] **Performance** (optimization to inference latency, memory, or rendering)
- [ ] **Refactoring** (code structure improvement with no behavioral change)
- [ ] **Documentation** (updates to README, API docs, or inline docstrings)

## Checklist

- [ ] Python unit tests pass locally (`pytest tests/ -v`)
- [ ] Frontend builds cleanly with zero TypeScript errors (`cd frontend && npm run build`)
- [ ] Code adheres to project formatting and typing conventions
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` have been updated where applicable
